summary.text: Glen Sturtevant is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia representing District 12.
The Senate biography lists Glen Sturtevant's service in the Senate from 2016 to 2020 and again since 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate biography, Glen Sturtevant was born in Wilmington, Delaware, on September 13, 1982.
Glen Sturtevant studied at Catholic University (B.A.) and George Mason University School of Law (J.D.).
Glen Sturtevant's listed occupation is attorney.
The biography lists Lori Cochrane Sturtevant as Glen Sturtevant's spouse.
The Senate page lists Glen Sturtevant's committee assignments as Courts of Justice, Local Government, and Transportation.
